value.rationale: Long-term memory is the defining design choice of NosAdam, and the source explicitly motivates its ability to recover after a large gradient. The result gives the exact boundary of that recovery: below gamma one the memory tail is polynomial, at gamma one it is logarithmic, and above gamma one recovery of the baseline denominator is incomplete. This is a direct, interpretable tuning law for the defining hyperharmonic parameter rather than an arbitrary scalar exercise.
